paragraph: A man in Washington Heights swept the same sidewalk block every day for a hundred days. Neighbors watched the broom move back and forth across the concrete. Some of them picked up brooms and joined him. The filthy gutters and littered corners became cleaner. In Eastern cultures, the lotus is a food source, an ornamental, and a religious symbol. It also grows best in the dirtiest water and still opens into bloom.
